title: Self-Adaptive Cognitive Debiasing for Large Language Models in Decision-Making

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the difference in LLM decisions between control prompts and treatment prompts that inject an initial reference point, such as dataset statistics, to influence the model's judgment.
Evaluating the shift in LLM outputs when prompts explicitly state a majority opinion or preference, comparing the results against an unbiased control group.
Assessing the change in LLM decision-making when treatment prompts introduce severe punishments for incorrect options, compared to neutral control prompts.
